description: Project domain overlay. User-owned: NEVER overwritten by an upgrade. Extends and overrides engine-artifacts.json. This example is filled with vocabulary from a real export-logistics project; use it as a shape reference, not as a default.

peopleNote: Personas ficticias. El overlay real de cada proyecto lleva los nombres de su equipo y NO se publica: vive en qa/00-standards/minutes/domain.json, que ningun upgrade toca.
